newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed to higher, trade active.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed to higher, trade active.

text.p: Croatian stocks closed mostly higher on Wednesday after the public holiday, with blue chips breaking new records in heavy trade.
* Nine of 18 active issues rose, four fell and five were flat.
* Volume rose to 25,230 from last Friday's 9,898 shares, turnover was almost four times higher at 18.6 million kuna.
* Most active drugs firm Pliva firmed 18 kuna to close at a new high of 584, selling 25,230 shares.
* Zagrebacka Banka climbed 150 kuna to 2,500 -- also a record -- with 4,016 units sold.
* Varazdinska Banka B-series preferred stock led gainers, adding 20 kuna or 13.3 percent to close at 170 kuna, with 160 shares sold.
* Biggest loser was ship repairer Viktor Lenac which shed 10 kuna or 6.25 percent to 150 kuna, selling 270 units.
